botMessages.message: Hi, I'm NextMission. I help veterans connect their military experience to civilian careers. What's your branch and specialty code, MOS, AFSC, Rating, or NEC? Or just describe what you did and I'll work from there.
Something went wrong on my end. Let's try again, what were you working on?

conversationVariables.description: The next topic to be visited
conversationVariables.label: Next Topic

conversationVariables.description: The veteran's own description of their military background. Collected in NM_Greeting_And_Background. Passed as userPrompt to get_cluster_data.
conversationVariables.label: User Description

conversationVariables.description: Result message from request_mentor_intro once the introduction has actually been created. Prevents sending twice.
conversationVariables.label: Intro Sent

conversationVariables.description: Grounded occupations ADJACENT to the direct crosswalk match, set by look_up_occupations when the code's row is thin. Present verbatim and ALWAYS as a wider set, never as what the code maps to.
conversationVariables.label: Adjacent Occupations

conversationVariables.description: One of the nine Next Mission clusters. Set by classify_cluster. Used only for mentor matching now; job and skills content comes from the O*NET occupations instead.
conversationVariables.label: Cluster Key

conversationVariables.description: Email address the veteran supplied for a mentor introduction. Set ONLY after they explicitly agree to an introduction. Its presence is the consent signal.
conversationVariables.label: Requester Email

conversationVariables.description: The veteran's military role title, e.g. Combat Medic Specialist, returned by look_up_occupations. Null when they described their background instead of giving a code.
conversationVariables.label: Role Title

conversationVariables.description: Civilian occupations this veteran's specialty code maps to, from the O*NET military crosswalk. Set by look_up_occupations in the greeting. Each entry is Title :: Description. Present verbatim, never invent entries.
conversationVariables.label: Occupations

conversationVariables.description: Military branch as stated by the veteran, normalised to one of the six service names.
conversationVariables.label: Branch

conversationVariables.description: Record Id of the mentor returned by find_mentor, as a string. Passed to request_mentor_intro. Never surfaced to the veteran.
conversationVariables.label: Mentor Id

conversationVariables.description: The wage lines already given to this veteran, set by get_wages. Its presence means they have SEEN figures. Never print the same figures again on a repeat ask.
conversationVariables.label: Wages Shown

conversationVariables.description: Runtime condition evaluation for if statements
conversationVariables.label: Runtime Condition 1
